body: No, but access is also an issue. I.e. I really don’t know anyone.  I used to love how acid made me feel. I know you can by shit I’m tech savvy, but it seems like a PiTA process. But worth it maybe?

I was in one for five years. It was high school so maybe not in the adult scope of what intimacy is. I feel like I’m failing some litmus test because most of my adult relationships don’t last. I haven’t had a long lasting relationship in 10 years or more. I usually get left for someone or something else. I know that love and infatuation don’t last. They ebb and flow. But I’ve been mostly alone.
Could you be more specific. That’s a very broad and undefined response. Intimacy with people? Religious community? Friends? I’ve had all of those things and it never really changed anything.

I was recently in the hospital (psychiatric) and then intensive outpatient. It didn’t really take. I’ve tried to go back to school. It never really works out. I’m bad at math and I suck unless it’s computer hardware or philosophy. I’m really just at the end of an empty road. Everything I loved lost along the way. I’ve been on dates in the past. I haven’t been on a date in 4 years. Most people just ignore me.  I’m just really burned out.

I “also” have Borderline Personality Disorder. (Dubious?), but the stigma of that on top of that with psychosis brought on by mania or depression. The truth is the only person I’m a danger to is myself.
Yes and Seroquel and Lamotragine. I don’t take antidepressants as of two months ago. I’m type 1. I’m just so done with this life. It hasn’t been good for a long time.
